reproduction: Before fix, minimized from-scratch DXF imported successfully with a LINE and an MLINE, but its loss report omitted MLINE.

The optional MLINE test imports locally generated LINE + MLINE DXF and ODA-converted AC1024 DWG, verifies one MLINE loss and one retained LINE in each, and checks a LINE-only DXF raises no MLINE loss. MPOLYGON and legacy layer tests also pass.
replay: Patch was applied in order to a local replay of the prior candidate and both changed files matched the committed consumer candidate.
limits: The candidate is local and unmerged. The callback reports omitted geometry; it does not implement MLINE rendering or editing. No native GUI, Linux, Windows or broader DWG/DXF qualification is implied. No drawings are committed; no phase gate or external-only support claim is promoted.
